questionPrompt: Read the passage below. Select every grammar error you notice by highlighting it. You may also type the correct version in the box that appears.
passageText: Many student in Vietnam believes that higher education are the only path to success. The government also support this view, as it invest heavily in universities every year.

falseAlarmZones.hint: 'Higher education' is an uncountable noun phrase used correctly here as the subject — it doesn't need an article or plural form.

errors.explanation: 'Many' requires a plural noun. 'Student' must be 'students'.
The subject 'Many students' is plural, so the verb must be 'believe', not 'believes'.
'Higher education' is an uncountable noun (singular) — it takes 'is', not 'are'.
'The government' is a singular noun — the verb must be 'supports'.
